title: Verify: Furniture and full room source size and palette unit tests
description: Write tests from the R3 criteria and the intent criteria across ROOM_SOURCES.
acceptance_criteria: Every ROOM_SOURCES grid has its declared size
Every grid renders with only palette colours and at least 3 distinct indices

steps.action: Create the file. Assert ROOM_SOURCES ids are unique and sorted names after stripping 'room/' equal Object.keys(ROOM_ART_SIZES) sorted. For each source assert frames.length 1, grid height and every row width equal ROOM_ART_SIZES[name].
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/roomSources.test.ts
steps.expected: Coverage and size tests pass for 13 ids

steps.action: For each source, collect the Set of indices; assert it has at least 3 members, every index is an integer in [0, PALETTE.length), and gridToRgba(frames[0], PALETTE) does not throw. Assert the bookshelf set includes rampIndex('plum',3), rampIndex('hoodie',3), rampIndex('lamp',3) and rampIndex('moon',3), the bed includes rampIndex('hoodie',3) and rampIndex('hoodie',2), and the door bottom row equals rampIndex('lamp',5) throughout.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/roomSources.test.ts
